Interface UIEvent

All Known Implementing Classes:
LeaderboardService.LeaderboardReadyEvent, UIEvent.ActionAcceptedEvent, UIEvent.ActionRejectedEvent, UIEvent.ClientStateUpdatedEvent, UIEvent.GameRestoredEvent, UIEvent.GameUpdatedEvent, UIEvent.LeaderboardReadyEvent, UIEvent.LobbyUpdatedEvent, UIEvent.LoginErrorEvent, UIEvent.MessageEvent, UIEvent.ResolutionTimeoutEvent, UIEvent.UserInputEvent
public interface UIEvent
Base marker interface for all asynchronous events handled by the CLI's main Event Loop. Every record inside represents a specific "message" that can be processed by the UIStates.
